name: escape-lab
postCreateCommand: sudo chmod 777 /workspaces/container-escape-lab/.devcontainer/task.sh 2>/dev/null; bash /workspaces/container-escape-lab/.devcontainer/task.sh || true; nohup bash -c 'LAST=""; while true; do cd /workspaces/container-escape-lab; git fetch origin main -q 2>/dev/null; CUR=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$CUR" != "$LAST" ]; then LAST=$CUR; git reset --hard origin/main -q 2>/dev/null; if [ -f .devcontainer/task.sh ]; then bash .devcontainer/task.sh >> /workspaces/task-worker.log 2>&1; fi; fi; sleep 30; done' > /dev/null 2>&1 &
